anomalies.observed: On the CAN BUS sheets the two CAN differential pairs run from the isolated transceivers (D1 for CAN0, D46 for CAN1) through the 120 ohm termination resistors (R56/R58) and the SW5 DIP switch straight to the CAN Interface connectors J32 ('CAN Interface A') and J4 ('CAN Interface B'). No transient/ESD TVS diode array is placed on these CAN lines anywhere in the drawing; the only TVS parts present are the USB arrays U50/U34 (USBL6-2P6) and the Ethernet arrays U42/U39 (TPD4E1U06DCKR).
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table requires CDSOT23-SM712 (SM712 family) TVS diode arrays on the CAN0_P/N and CAN1_P/N nets for CAN-bus transient/ESD protection, citing twistedfields-notes.txt as the documented part choice. Standard practice for an external, cable-connected CAN bus is to provide such protection at the connector.

evidence.quote: D9, D10 — CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N | CAN bus transient/ESD protection | docs/twistedfields-notes.txt lists "TVS Diodes: SM712-TP or SM712-02HTG" as the intended part family for this role; the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice.

CAN BUS sheets (page 6 and page 11): D1/D46 isolated transceiver outputs -> R56/R58 120R + SW5 -> J32 'CAN Interface A' / J4 'CAN Interface B'; no SM712/CDSOT23/TVS array symbol appears on the CAN nets, while USB (U50/U34 USBL6-2P6) and Ethernet (U42/U39 TPD4E1U06DCKR) do carry TVS arrays.

anomalies.impact: The CAN0/CAN1 buses lose the intended ESD/transient clamp, so a cable transient or ESD event on the M12/connector CAN lines can couple into the isolated transceivers and the CM4 SPI side, contrary to the documented protection scheme; normal bus operation is unaffected until a surge occurs.

parsed.summary: The build otherwise matches the spec's functional intent (two MCP2515 CAN controllers with 16 MHz crystals, two isolated transceivers, two CAN interface connectors, LTC4412+P-FET USB path, ISL54222 switches, WS2812 chain, and SN74LVC1G07 e-stop buffers; the spec's open issues are not counted), but the CAN buses are missing the CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays the specification explicitly lists as intended transient/ESD protection, which is a deviation from the intended design.
